title: Pakistani businessman ‘bought Thai ID’ 20 years ago
summary: A Pakistani fabric store owner in Pattani province has been arrested for allegedly using the identity of a Thai national to obtain a Thai ID card, allowing him to live and run a business in Thailand for nearly 20 years.
